All papers these notes use. Counts not yet filled in. A dash means no count yet. **Status** is the mark described
in [About these notes](/about/). **Bears on** names the [open questions](/questions/) and
[model rungs](/simulations/model-ladder/) a paper is used for; papers without an entry there are
not yet tagged. The same papers grouped by topic are in the
[bibliography](/resources/bibliography/); the ones to read next are in the
[reading queue](/resources/reading-queue/), and [papers.bib](/papers.bib) has them as BibTeX.

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **review** | Survey of a field. |
| **experiment** | Measurements of spokes or of a discharge. |
| **simulation** | PIC, fluid or other spatially resolved numerical model. |
| **theory** | Analytic or phenomenological model. |
| **model** | Global or ionization region model (0D, volume averaged). |
| **unclassified** | Known only from a reference list; type to be checked. |

<style>
#paper-filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 1rem; align-items: center; margin-block: 1rem; }
#paper-table th[data-sort] { cursor: pointer; }
#paper-table th[data-sort]::after { content: ' ↕'; opacity: 0.4; }
</style>

<script>
(() => {
	const box = document.getElementById('paper-filters');
	const table = document.querySelector('#paper-table table');
	if (!box || !table) return;
	box.hidden = false;
	const body = table.tBodies[0];
	const rows = [...body.rows];
	const col = { type: 2, status: 3 };
	const apply = () => {
		const v = Object.fromEntries([...box.querySelectorAll('[data-filter]')].map((e) => [e.dataset.filter, e.value.trim().toLowerCase()]));
		for (const r of rows) {
			const c = [...r.cells].map((x) => x.textContent.toLowerCase());
			r.hidden =
				(v.type && !c[col.type].startsWith(v.type)) ||
				(v.status && c[col.status] !== v.status) ||
				(v.text && !c.join(' ').includes(v.text));
		}
	};
	box.addEventListener('input', apply);
	const num = (s) => (/^\d+$/.test(s) ? Number(s) : -1);
	[...table.tHead.rows[0].cells].forEach((th, i) => {
		th.dataset.sort = '';
		let dir = 1;
		th.addEventListener('click', () => {
			const numeric = i === 1 || i === 5;
			rows.sort((a, b) => {
				const x = a.cells[i].textContent.trim();
				const y = b.cells[i].textContent.trim();
				return dir * (numeric ? num(x) - num(y) : x.localeCompare(y));
			});
			dir = -dir;
			rows.forEach((r) => body.append(r));
		});
	});
})();
</script>
